trainers.label: SimpleTuner
trainers.note: A separate trainer with its own Python. Trains on audio clips with captions, saves checkpoints, renders audio samples and can resume.
install: cd SimpleTuner && python3.12 -m venv venv && venv/bin/pip install -e .

Download the MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-Music3 parts it loads into your models folder, under diffusers/MiniMax-Music3: transformer, language_model, dav.pth, rvq_depth_decoder, vocoder, condition_encoder and the small config files (about 27 GB).
Set STUDIO_TRAINER_SIMPLETUNER_PYTHON to venv/bin/python, then restart the studio.
missing: SimpleTuner installed in its own Python, set in STUDIO_TRAINER_SIMPLETUNER_PYTHON.
